Sir Jeffrey Donaldson, former DUP leader, was found guilty of 18 sex abuse charges, including rape. His conviction has caused a political earthquake in Northern Ireland, damaging the DUP's reputation and election prospects.

The Bright Side:
The legal system functioned without bias, proving that even the most powerful political figures are not above the law, providing a measure of closure for victims.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here; the WHO and WHAT are aligned. The bait-and-switch was the persona of the 'family man' politician used to mask criminal behavior.

Social Physics Analysis:
Donaldson maintained a facade of moral authority to hide his actions. The DUP's silence during the trial shows how political parties often prioritize self-preservation over transparency when faced with internal rot.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The collapse of his personal morality forces a systemic reckoning.

The Unavoidable Truth: Power was used to facilitate abuse.

The Unavoidable Lie: The political party was unaware of the risks.
